instances.claim: This tells me that the film has already introduced a bounded set of Cent objects — more than one, with fixed membership, all alike when they started — that these quantifiers can range over.
instances.why: Lines 1–5 introduce only a singular object: 'One cent', 'The readymade he chose', 'The object'. Nothing establishes a collection, so 'Every Cent' and then 'Each object, initially identical' — a claim about a population's starting state — both quantify over a set the draft never brought into being; the two lines float on the same absent premise.

instances.claim: This tells me that the object had been destroyed, dematerialized, or otherwise lost its physical existence before this point, and that it persisted anyway.
instances.why: 'Remained' and 'buoyed into physicality' both presuppose a prior threat to the object's physical existence, but nothing before line 5 mentions destruction, loss, or an image standing in for the thing — the only destruction in the draft arrives nine lines later, at 14, so the push-against state is not in the piece when the line is read.
